name: Interview
description: Capture an interview's answers and examples, then add a clearly labeled review and up to two practical improvements.

sections.title: Interview Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the interview's purpose and main substance as factual recap. Identify the interviewee or topic only when clear from the transcript.

sections.title: Key Answers
sections.instruction: Summarize the interviewee's most important answers and the questions they addressed. Preserve distinctions between what was asked, answered, and left unanswered.

sections.title: Examples & Evidence
sections.instruction: Capture concrete experiences, examples, results, or supporting details the interviewee gave. Do not invent achievements, numbers, or verbatim quotes.

sections.title: Interview Review
sections.instruction: Give a brief, explicitly subjective impression of how clearly and specifically the interviewee answered, grounded in particular answers. For a behavioral job interview, discuss how well their examples covered Situation, Task, their own Action, and Result (STAR); for other interview types, review answer quality without forcing STAR. Do not assign a score or infer a hiring decision or personal traits.

sections.title: Improvements for Next Time
sections.instruction: Suggest one or two concrete ways the interviewee could improve future interviews, based on specific answers in this recording. Treat these as coaching suggestions, not facts about the person; omit the section if the recording does not support a useful suggestion.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: List only follow-up actions explicitly agreed or requested during the interview, with owner and timing only when stated. Omit this section when there are none.
